(BY SHRI ASHISH KURMI - PANEL LAWYER,
 PROSECUTRIX IS PRESENT IN PERSON ALONGWITH HER COUNSEL  SHRI UPENDRA SINGH - ADVOCATE)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.566/2023 registered at Police Station Garha, District Jabalpur (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376 and 376(2)n of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 16.09.2023.
2.

As per the prosecution story, the prosecutrix lodged a report against the accused person that she was in love relationship with him and on the basis of false promise the accused lived with her since 10.06.2023 to 30.09.2023 and committed rape with her due to which the prosecutrix got pregnant.
Thereafter, he left the prosecutrix.

On the basis of above report, Police registered the FIR against the applicant for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 376(2)n of IPC.
3 .
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is in detention since 16.09.2023.
He is innocent.

He further submits that he left the prosecutrix in search of employment for more than a week and when the prosecutrix reached police station to lodge missing complaint, the police Santosh Gotiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47177233/
1 registered a crime for rape against the applicant.

sentences.text: He further submits that the applicant has married the prosecutrix and they have a child out of their wedlock.
He has produced discharge ticket in which name of applicant is written as a husband of prosecutrix.
The applicant has no criminal past.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
The trial of the case will take considerable time and for this reason applicant may not be in jail for indefinite period.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Prosecutrix is present in court and she has stated that she has no objection if applicant is released on bail.

6. Having taken into consideration the entirety of allegations and material available on record but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.

Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant,
stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant - Santosh Gotiya be released on bail on h is furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
